title: NoMaD: Goal Masked Diffusion Policies for Navigation and Exploration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
abstract: Robotic learning for navigation in unfamiliar environments needs to provide policies for both task-oriented navigation (i.e., reaching a goal that the robot has located), and task-agnostic exploration (i.e., searching for a goal in a novel setting). title: Marginalizing and Conditioning Gaussians onto Linear Approximations of Smooth Manifolds with Applications in Robotics
